candidates.description: Wall Street worst week stole the spotlight this week. Wall Street worst week since March 2020: the S&P 500 fell 8.61% to 6,910.39 and the Nasdaq dropped 10.02%, wiping out its 2026 gains, as chip stocks crashed and the VIX jumped to 35.89. Nvidia posted record revenue of $115.8 billion and guided above estimates, yet its shares fell 22.9% on reports of an SEC probe and a California subpoena. Anthropic raised about $81.3 billion in the largest IPO on record, December Fed hike odds rose to 92%

companies.SalesMind AI: BLOCK71 Singapore-resident sales-AI startup. Drop unrelated 'SalesMind' branded vendors (Salesmind.ai LinkedIn outreach, etc.) unless the article explicitly references this BLOCK71 SG entity.
